items.q: How do I book a session?
a: Choose a service on the services page and press Book this service. You pick your date, time and details in our secure booking panel, which is powered by Square, and Square sends your confirmation.

items.q: Can I see the studio before I book?
a: Yes. Studio visits are free and take 30 minutes. Book a studio visit.

items.q: Why do membership sessions show as free?
a: Membership sessions are covered by your membership, so there's nothing to pay when you book them. If you haven't paid for a membership, you'll pay in person at the session.

Sessions are booked through the official Disco Sundays scheduling system. Booking priority and how far ahead you can reserve vary by membership tier, and a specific studio or time isn't guaranteed. The booking panel always shows the times that are open right now.

items.q: How do I change or cancel a booking?
a: Call or text (443) 401-5425 or email ohitsdiscosundays@gmail.com and we'll help you sort it out.

items.q: What does the Unlimited membership include?
a: 24/7 studio access with no contracts, up to 4 hours a day. Your music is uploaded for A&R review, and we help with booking shows. The membership includes access to one location. See the Unlimited membership.

It's our Personal Audio Engineer Plan: a personal audio engineer handles all your audio needs, and sessions include mixing and live video performance. It's available only at the Hanover location. See the Creator Membership.
Membership fees are billed monthly and renew automatically each billing cycle unless you cancel before the renewal date. Fees are non-refundable once charged.

items.q: Do unused studio hours roll over?
a: No. Each membership includes a set number of studio hours per month, and they need to be used within the active billing cycle unless Disco Sundays agrees otherwise in writing.

Disco Sundays is based in Hanover, Maryland, and also partners with independent recording studios. Memberships give access to studio time at participating partner studios, depending on your tier. The Creator Membership is available only in Hanover, and the Unlimited membership covers one location. Members follow each partner studio's rules and policies.
Engineering, production, premium equipment and other add-ons may be offered at an additional cost. The Creator Membership includes a personal audio engineer.

items.q: What am I responsible for during a session?
a: Members are responsible for their own conduct while using the studios, and for any damage they cause to studio property.

items.q: What is the Disco Sundays Crash Test?
a: A one-hour artist evaluation. We talk through your sound, goals and current stage, evaluate your music and delivery, test your presence in the booth or live, and finish with a clear recommendation for your next steps. It isn't an audition. It's your blueprint. See the Crash Test.
